title: Product Plan
subtitle: Sell The Agent Dashboard Setup
intro: Researched plan with sources. Prices marked Estimate are proposals to test, not market facts.

close.title: Your Picks Shape The Plan
close.text: Vote on each card, pick A or B on the choices, then send your picks. Research turns them into the final plan.

cards.label: What You Already Built
cards.line: 18 agents, each with its own phone dashboard, a 5 AM Morning Report, a 6 PM Evening Report and swipe decks to decide.
cards.next: Package the daily rhythm, not the 18 agents.

cards.label: The Market Is Growing Fast
cards.line: Forecast: AI agents grow from $7.84B (2025) to $52.62B (2030). Yet under 20% of US firms with 4 or fewer staff use AI.

source2.title: US Census BTOS: AI use by firm size, May 2026

cards.next: Read it as room to grow among small firms, not a sales number.

cards.label: What Others Charge
cards.line: DIY agent tools run about $20 to $100 a month. A managed AI employee service charges $2,000 once plus $500 a month.

source.title: ATI Lab managed AI employee pricing

cards.next: Price between DIY tools and full managed services.

cards.label: What Buyers Complain About
cards.line: Top Sintra complaint: credits run out fast. Lindy users report runaway runs burning credits and hard cancels.

source.title: Crevio: Sintra AI review and complaints, 2026

source2.title: Lindy Community: credit burn bug report

cards.next: Sell a flat monthly price with no credits to count.

cards.label: Where You Are Different
cards.line: Others sell chat and credits. Yours is a daily rhythm: report, swipe to decide, done, on the phone, in your brand.

source.title: The Verge: OpenAI sunsets Pulse daily digests, Jun 2026

cards.next: Lead with the decision step. OpenAI dropped its daily digest, so a brief alone is not the edge.

cards.label: Who To Sell To First
cards.line: Contractors already pay Jobber $29 to $599 a month, and your construction network can introduce pilots.
cards.next: Research picks A. Property managers later: tenant data means more privacy work.

optionA.label: Small Contractors
optionA.desc: 2 to 10 person crews you can reach through your network.

optionB.label: Solopreneurs
optionB.desc: Biggest online crowd, cheapest to reach, likely to shop on price.

cards.label: How To Package It
cards.line: A done-for-you service needs no new software to start. ATI Lab sells one managed AI role at $2,000 plus $500 a month.
cards.next: Research picks A now; a kit or SaaS can follow once pilots prove it.

optionA.label: Done-For-You Setup
optionA.desc: You set it up and tune it monthly. Higher price, real feedback.

optionB.label: Template Kit
optionB.desc: They set it up themselves. Low price, no support load, less learning.

cards.label: Pricing Tiers To Test
cards.line: Estimate. Sits between DIY tools ($20 to $100 a month) and managed services ($2,000 plus $500 a month).
cards.next: Show the Pilot price on the landing page and see who pays.

mock.title: Proposed Tiers
rows: Two reports a day, one deck
Only after the app is built

cards.label: First Version: Three Lanes
cards.line: Ship the daily rhythm for 3 lanes, not 18 agents. More lanes become upsells after a pilot shows value.
cards.next: Pick the 3 lanes with the first pilot (for example Office, Jobs, Marketing).

cards.label: Build Before You Sell
cards.line: GitHub Pages terms rule out commercial SaaS and sensitive data, so client pages need private hosting with login.
cards.next: Private login, votes saved to a server, one workspace per client, Stripe billing.

mock.title: Sign In To Your Team
rows: Billing And Cancel In One Tap

cards.label: How To Find Buyers
cards.line: Warm intros usually close faster than content (Research judgment). The blog builds a list in the background.
cards.next: Research picks A first, B in parallel. The YouTube channel's audience fits less.

optionA.label: Construction Network
optionA.desc: Ten warm conversations in two weeks; show your own phone.

optionB.label: Blog Build In Public
optionB.desc: Posts like How I Run 18 AI Agents; slower, builds a waitlist.

cards.label: Risks To Plan For
cards.line: Gartner predicts over 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by end of 2027 over cost, value and risk.
cards.next: Sell a clear daily outcome and read the agent platform's terms before reselling.

cards.label: The 30, 60, 90 Day Path
cards.line: Day 30: 3 paid pilots. Day 60: pilots live on private login. Day 90: grow, change or stop.
cards.next: Approve the first test below to start Day 1.

cards.label: First Test: Waitlist Plus 3 Pilots
cards.line: One page with the price shown, plus 10 warm talks. If fewer than 3 pay after 20 talks, rethink the offer.

source.title: GitHub Pages limits (landing page is fine, no payments on it)

cards.next: Research drafts the landing page copy; Max picks the name.
